title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E = 2.225 GeV for reaction 1 with target dissociating into a proton and 4 pions.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E = 2.225 GeV for reaction 1 with projectile dissociating into a proton and 4 pions.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E = 3.847 GeV for reaction 2 with both protons dissociating into a proton and 8 pions.

title: Correct Use of Invariant Mass
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the invariant mass formula S = (E + m_p)^2 - p_p^2 in their calculations.

title: Energy Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in deriving the energy expressions for each reaction.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations, particularly for energy and mass.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the mass-energy equivalence.

title: Final Result Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present final answers clearly, including units and formatting.
